launches.title: Theneo - Generate Stripe-like API Docs & Developer Portals
launches.tagline: Theneo is the quickest, simplest way to generate high-quality, interactive API docs. Just import your API collection and we'll take care of the rest.
launches.body:
Hey there,

Ana from Theneo. Theneo is a tool for generating Stripe-like API Docs. Using AI, we are the first company to automate the full life cycle of documentation, from generating content to publishing. Theneo was built with the belief that generating high-quality, interactive documentation should not be tedious and we provide the tool to do just that. Theneo is used in production by more than 8000 companies

Using Theneo you can:

* Build interactive API docs
* Taylor your documentation
* Update docs automatically (via IDE extensions and github integration)
* Built for everyone
* Bring all of your docs together with the Developer Portal
* Let your users test APIs using the API Explorer

Some of the APIs and Developer Portals generate in Theneo

* Developer Portal for Uome , perfect example how your API catalague can look like in Theneo <https://developers.myuome.com/> 
* <https://developers.paymob.com/> Paymobs interactive docs and developer portals, all built in Theneo 

For Startup Community we are offering 6 months free access to our business package. Email us at [hello@theneo.io](mailto:hello@theneo.io), email subject YC Startup Community
